caption: : Eval PPL. under different Shared Sub-Dim ratio settings.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the shared sub-dimensions ratio and the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) for two models, Transformer and MoHD. The x-axis represents the shared sub-dims to total sub-dims ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0/4 to 4/4 in increments of 1/4. The y-axis represents Eval PPL, with a linear scale ranging from 10.0 to 12.5 in increments of 0.5. The Transformer model is represented by a red dashed line, which remains constant at approximately 11.7 across the entire x-axis range. In contrast, the MoHD model is represented by a blue solid line with circle markers, starting at around 10.9 when the shared sub-dims ratio is 0/4, decreasing to a minimum of approximately 10.3 at a ratio of 3/4, and then increasing to around 10.7 at a ratio of 4/4.
